_comment: C0-15 llama-cpp bodies EN. 无附加小节。正文「相关条目」2 行带 .md 链接（ollama/koboldcpp），related 写 2 条（frontmatter related 是 [openai-agents-sdk, llamaindex]，键按正文链接行对齐=2）。sources 3 条对齐 frontmatter。runs 无「实测建议」段（引用 models 站 guides 快照口径），照源短译。

axes.model_access: The ecosystem root of the GGUF format — the models-site quantization index is built to llama.cpp's framing; safetensors convertible; the supported-model list rolls with merges, not inventoried item by item.
axes.runtime: A C/C++ inference library + llama-server (REST API) + various backends (CUDA/Metal/Vulkan/CPU etc., per docs/build.md); the official install entry now includes the llama.app script (as seen in the README, direct-fetched). GitHub 132,794★ (API verified 2026-10-21).
axes.local_files: Fully local: model files and conversation outputs live in your own environment; no official cloud line seen — third-party cloud hosting does not count as official.
axes.background: llama-server stays resident as a service; concurrency/quantization scheduling details not verified item by item.
axes.tools: The server side has a function-calling docs line; MCP support status — no official statement verified.
axes.context: Context length is set by runtime parameters (-c etc.); KV-cache quantization has official docs (precedent: the learn-site KV-cache entry's refs backlink).
axes.permissions: A local process with no account system; llama-server authentication is configured by the deploying party; no cloud permission surface seen.
axes.fit: Fits: fine-grained control (quantization tiers/backends/parameters), running GGUF on consumer hardware, serving as the base for downstream tools. Does not fit: wanting a GUI out of the box (use LM Studio/KoboldCpp); multi-model high-throughput service deployment (vLLM/SGLang).

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. The models-site guides' `serving-deep-dive.md` has already verified llama.cpp's official framing (compared against vLLM/SGLang), and this dossier's format/quantization axes directly reuse that snapshot's sources. No runner-specific test protocol exists on this site yet.
unknowns:
- The full supported-model list (rolls with merges, not inventoried item by item)
- MCP support status (no official statement verified)
- Details of the official relationship between llama.app and the GitHub repo (the install entry was seen in the README direct fetch; site ownership not separately verified)
related: The generation that built an out-of-the-box experience on top of llama.cpp; for low-level control return to this dossier.
